description: Type creating a materialized view over a table that is still being created or modified (HTTP 400). It surfaced as a generic BadRequest, so the provider matched the message to retry it.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: A table referenced by the materialized view query is still being created or modified (HTTP 400: '... while it is being created or modified'). Retryable after a short wait.

message.includes: while it is being created or modified
